Mechanical seams are clean: Movement→Curves is now verified real (gate-2's provisional item resolved — Curves .05 opens on a clean band-loop entry, base rig owns the handoff), Curves→MWR and MWR→Hands blend without pose jumps, and Straps' converge beat opens clean off Hands. The strongest new cross-section thread is the BPM catalog motif: 01/02/03 page rail, 58→96→142 over the fixed /220, identical figure-block anatomy across Curves/Hands/Straps — it reads as consecutive pages of one catalog exactly as designed, and every count lands its value dead on the capture beat. Three continuity debts: (1) the global dial hot-glow (gate-2's #1 tune) is still unapplied in this build and now degrades Curves and MWR's money frames too — one spec.ts owner, one re-capture wave; (2) the porcelain run Curves→Straps has a lighting-continuity arc the keyframe table doesn't intend: ink dial at rot 170 → milk-veiled at 200 → blown white sheet at 225 → clean band macro at 250; the live-attitude env sweeps (§1.4 fix 5) were only ever run at solo attitudes, and the two middle sections pay for it — the sweep debt is now the wave's defining defect class; (3) the numbered eyebrow rail skips 07: Movement is 06, Curves ships 'CATALOG · 01/03' with no section number, then MWR 08 / Hands 09 / Straps 10 — one-line fix but it breaks the site's numbering spine.
